name: (a) days rule decides flags and order
threshold_direction: flag when the value is at or below the threshold
queue_order: fewest business days until start first; equal day counts have equal priority (the order within a day count is not meaningful; assessment ID is used only to display a stable order)
tie_rule: flags use cutoffs, so equal scores receive equal flag decisions; fixed-volume comparisons report the expected result across tied orders, with the whole tied group included or excluded as a sensitivity check
evaluation_eligibility: known-outcome assessments made before the task's deadline, using notebook 01's rules; assessments whose outcome is unknown at the extract are excluded from scoring
operational_eligibility: assessments of unfinished tasks made before the deadline; the eventual outcome is not required to generate a suggestion
overdue_handling: assessments at or past the deadline go to a separate urgent-review list and are always reviewed

queue_rules.note: operating rules for applying the frozen policy; they were not evaluated in this retrospective validation
queue_rules.entry: a task enters the list when one of its assessments is flagged by the policy
queue_rules.deduplication: one entry per task; a later assessment of a task already on the list updates its entry (current days until start, status) rather than adding a second one
queue_rules.active_until: an entry stays active from its first flag until the team records completion; it is not removed because a later assessment would not have been flagged on its own
queue_rules.priority: recomputed from each task's current values whenever the list is refreshed, using the queue order above
queue_rules.removal: a task leaves the list when the team records completion; the coordinator then confirms completion
queue_rules.missing_or_invalid_input: the days rule needs only a valid days-until-start value; a task without one is not dropped but goes to the coordinator as 'needs manual check', outside the ranked list. If the model is used, a missing intake channel is handled with the documented 'unknown' category; any other missing or invalid required input also sends the task to 'needs manual check'
queue_rules.high_impact_label: payroll, system access or workplace access with 5 or fewer days until start is shown as a label only; it does not add flags or change the order

unknown_input_handling: days rule: needs only business days until start, which every assessment has; model (if used): missing intake channel is coded 'unknown', unseen categories are encoded as zeros
human_review: a person confirms every follow-up; the list only suggests what to review
missing or invalid inputs: 'needs manual check'

decision_criteria.precedence: (b) if its criterion holds, otherwise (c) if its criterion holds, otherwise (a)
decision_criteria.criteria_apply_to: each candidate's specified assessment-level flagging rule (the saved full-precision threshold for b) or retrospective queue ordering (rule flags with model order for c); persistent live-queue behaviour is documented in queue_rules and was not evaluated; matched-volume results are supporting evidence only

closest_group_to_review_trigger: employee_type = permanent: recall 81.5%, -9.8 points from the policy's overall recall (review trigger -10), 54 at-risk assessments
chosen_on: validation (1,033 early-warning assessments); development criteria fixed before this notebook's comparison
frozen_before: the single test evaluation and the time-based check; neither result had been opened
